sense: people coming together to talk about work

pins.definition: An occasion when people come together to discuss work or official matters.
A planned gathering where people talk about work tasks, projects, or decisions.
An organized meeting of a group of people, such as at work or school.

situation: Four colleagues gathered around an office desk covered in architectural blueprints, pointing and discussing their project.
subject: people coming together around a table to talk about work
brief: Four professionals stand shoulder-to-shoulder around a wide wooden table spread with large open blueprints and scattered notes. One woman points a pen toward a building sketch while the others lean in closely, listening and talking. Overhead, a simple pendant lamp casts a bright circle of light directly onto the documents and their hands.
prompt: Four professionals stand shoulder-to-shoulder around a wide wooden table spread with large open blueprints and scattered notes. One woman points a pen toward a building sketch while the others lean in closely, listening and talking. Overhead, a simple pendant lamp casts a bright circle of light directly onto the documents and their hands. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
